items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Lou Shubie (PHONETIC), who's the CBS contractor back there, when they were using studio bands, I would go and check the bands playing in the studios

ctx.x: You know. And, oh, I did some research. Lou Shubie (PHONETIC), who's the CBS contractor back there, when they were using studio bands, I would go and check the bands playing in the studios, and I told Harry, I said, 'We'll have to come outside and get the big heavyweights.' And he said, 'Man, do what you want to do. I've got it straight with the network.' And the music turned out that way, you know?
